— Why Deye

Why installers are
switching to Deye.

Founded in 1990, Deye is a global leader in inverter and energy storage technology. With over 30% market share in multiple countries and more than 1,000,000 systems deployed worldwide, Deye builds energy infrastructure for the real world — engineered for reliability, designed for scale.

35+ years of manufacturing. 1,000,000+ systems worldwide. Clean Australian safety record. Here's what makes Deye different from every other battery on the market.

01 — True Blackstart

Restarts from solar alone.
No grid. No internet.

Deye cold-starts from zero using only solar input and powers the entire home. Most competing systems require grid presence to restart from a fully depleted state. Deye doesn't. This is the single most important technical differentiator in the Australian market.

4ms
Grid-to-backup switchover
2×
Rated power surge (10s)
02 — Clean Safety Record

Zero ACCC recalls
in Australia.

No safety incidents recorded on the ACCC Product Safety Australia register. LFP chemistry — no cobalt, non-toxic, thermally stable. Built-in multi-level fire protection with aerosol suppression that detects smoke, combustible gases, and temperature anomalies for automatic response. IP65 rated for full outdoor installation.

1M+
Systems installed globally
100+
Countries
03 — Genuine Off-Grid

Generator input. AC coupling.
EV charging. All standard.

Every Deye system ships with full off-grid capability out of the box. Not firmware-locked upgrades. Not premium add-ons. Generator input, AC coupling, and controlled EV charger output — all built in.

6-in-1
Integrated design
97.6%
Max efficiency
04 — Premium Value

Premium functionality.
Without the premium price tag.

Deye packs genuine off-grid architecture, blackstart capability, built-in gateway, and Deye Cloud smart energy management into every system — features that competing brands charge extra for or simply don't offer. The result: a system that outperforms on capability without the inflated price point. More value for homeowners, a stronger proposition for installers.
